title: Disaggregating Census Data for Population Mapping Using Random Forests with Remotely-Sensed and Ancillary Data

idea.research_question: What spatial associations can be identified between census population, remote-sensing covariates and ancillary spatial data?
idea.hypothesis: The associated data components contain a joint spatial or temporal signal that is not represented by a single component alone.
idea.mechanism: Align the required components, construct comparable features, estimate associations and compare against single-component baselines.
idea.analytical_approach: Multisource spatial or temporal association analysis with robustness and ablation checks
idea.expected_contribution: A reproducible benchmark for testing association discovery across the selected data components.
idea.falsification_condition: Reject if any required component is absent or not jointly represented in the research instance.
